test_title: RRB ALP CBT-I 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 25 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which award has been conferred to Ram Chet Chaudhary in the field of Science and Engineering in 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Padma Shri**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• For the year 2024, the President approved conferment of 132 Padma awards, up from 106 such awards last year.
 
• The list comprises five Padma Vibhushan, 17 Padma Bhushan and 110 Padma Shri awards.
 
• While 30 awardees are women, the list also includes nine persons from the category of “Foreigners/NRI/PIO/OCI” and nine posthumous awardees.
 
• Late M Fathima Beevi, the first female of the Supreme Court of India and the first Muslim woman to be appointed to any of the higher judiciary in the country, who passed away recently, has been awarded Padma Bhushan (posthumously).
 
• Gouri Lakshmi Bayi, has written on the temples of erstwhile Travancore and Kerala, besides anthologies in English.
